allow: PowerShell($p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name='engram.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { $p | Select-Object ProcessId, ExecutablePath, CommandLine | Format-List } else { Write-Output "No engram.exe process found by that name" }; Write-Output "=== Get-Command ==="; try { \(Get-Command engram -ErrorAction Stop\).Source } catch { Write-Output "engram NOT on PowerShell PATH" }; Write-Output "=== Listener on 7437 ==="; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7437 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c | ForEach-Object { $pr = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess; "$\($pr.ProcessName\) [PID $\($pr.Id\)] -> $\($pr.Path\)" } } else { "nothing listening" })
